dedupe_keys.name: municipal solid waste generation and management indicators in azerbaijan 2017 2025

description: Nushaba Qadimli and Ulvi Mammadov compile annual municipal-waste generation and management indicators for Azerbaijan from 2017 to 2025. The source is the State Statistical Committee's annual publications. Variables cover waste generation, municipal waste's share of total waste, landfill disposal, energy recovery, domestic waste sales and electricity generation from waste. The deposit distinguishes official indicators from quantities and annual changes calculated by the authors, who report no interpolation of missing historical values. CSV and Excel tables, a data dictionary and a source list are available free under CC BY 4.0. These national annual series can inform waste-treatment capacity and material-flow scenarios. They do not describe individual facilities or seasonal variation. The related regional projections are a separate deposit being reviewed in this task; no existing catalogue record is directly linked by the source.
